primary_sources.hollow_sections: SCI P363 Steel Building Design: Design Data, reprinted 2015, ISBN 978-1-85942-186-4 (Tata Steel / BCSA / SCI)
primary_sources.hollow_mass_cross_check: Tata Steel Hybox S355J2H datasheet TST95:0122 (2022), mass-per-metre tables to EN 10219

_meta.units: SI (mm, mm^2, mm^3, mm^4, mm^6, kg/m)
_meta.props_convention: x = strong axis (EN y-y), y = weak axis (EN z-z). Zx_mm3/Zy_mm3 = ELASTIC modulus (Wel); Sx_mm3/Sy_mm3 = PLASTIC modulus (Wpl). Matches AU record convention. J_mm4 = EN torsion constant I_T, Iw_mm6 = warping constant I_w, C_mm3 (hollow) = torsion modulus W_t.
_meta.hollow_notes: hot-finished (EN 10210-2): ro = 1.5t, ri = 1.0t. cold-formed (EN 10219-2): ro = 2t (t<=6), 2.5t (6<t<=10), 3t (t>10); ri = 1t, 1.5t, 2t respectively. Properties therefore differ between the two for the same size.
